name: Toolbar Headless
description: A headless extension that adds three tool buttons: draw a cube, a cylinder, or a pyramid.
creator: SketchUp Team

draw-cube.title: Draw a Cube
draw-cube.description: Ask for a height, then draw a cube with that edge length.

draw-cylinder.title: Draw a Cylinder
draw-cylinder.description: Ask for a height, then draw a 100 inch wide cylinder that tall.

draw-pyramid.title: Draw a Pyramid
draw-pyramid.description: Ask for a height, then draw a square pyramid that tall.

where-are-my-tools.title: Toolbar Headless
where-are-my-tools.description: Explain where to find this extension's three tool buttons.
